about: Eval cases for POST /api/ask (Ask Nova). Drafted by Claude from docs/*.md on 2026-09-30, pending review by Arian. `expect.route` is the path the request should take; `expect.sources` are doc ids that a correct answer should cite; `gold` lists the facts a correct answer contains, quoted from the docs.

cases.message: Do you have a Microsoft Teams integration?
gold: No native Microsoft Teams integration yet
It is on the public roadmap but not scheduled
Workaround: route Teams requests through the web form or a shared email alias

cases.message: How do requesters file a ticket from Slack?
gold: A /northline command files a ticket without leaving Slack
Agents can reply inline and the thread syncs back to the ticket

cases.message: What outbound events can webhooks notify us about?
gold: Ticket created
Status changed
SLA breached

cases.message: How long does it take to go live?
gold: Most teams go live in under a week
A typical rollout is five days

cases.message: What happens to our old inbox on go-live day?
gold: The old inbox or tracker is set to read-only
New requests flow through Northline exclusively

cases.message: Can we import our open tickets from a spreadsheet?
gold: Yes, from a spreadsheet using the provided CSV template
Or from a prior tool via built-in migration connectors

cases.message: When does Nova start learning from our tickets?
gold: It activates automatically once the workspace has 30 days of ticket history
Before that it runs in a cold-start mode using category defaults

cases.message: What does Nova's smart routing actually do?
gold: Learns from past assignments and current team load
Routes new requests to the right queue automatically
Teams typically see unassigned-ticket time drop by half in the first month

cases.message: How does Nova predict SLA breaches?
gold: Anomaly alerts flag SLA risk before a ticket breaches
Based on queue velocity and historical resolution time, not just a fixed timer

cases.message: Is our ticket data used to train models for other customers?
gold: No
Ticket data stays within the workspace's data boundary and is not used to train models shared across other customers

cases.message: Can we keep our data in the EU?
gold: Enterprise workspaces can request a dedicated data residency region: US, EU, or APAC
At no extra cost

cases.message: Are you SOC 2 certified?
gold: SOC 2 Type II, renewed annually
A third-party penetration test each year, summary available under NDA

cases.message: How do I turn Nova off?
gold: Admins can disable Nova at the workspace level in Settings → AI
Without affecting any non-AI functionality

cases.message: Is Northline a project management tool?
gold: No, it is not a general-purpose project management tool
It is scoped to request/ticket operational work such as IT requests, facilities, and HR case management

cases.message: What setups do customers usually switch from?
gold: A shared email inbox
A spreadsheet-based tracker
A general-purpose project tool bent into a ticket queue

cases.message: Which channels can requests come in through, and when in the rollout do we connect them?
gold: Channels: email, web forms, Slack, and the API
The primary email inbox is connected on day 1
Web form and Slack are connected on day 4

cases.message: Does Nova keep the draft replies it writes, and where does it get the context for them?
gold: Drafts are generated per request and not persisted beyond the session
Drafts pull context from linked tickets, past resolutions, and the requester's history

cases.message: What about Teams?

history.content: Yes. A /northline command lets requesters file tickets from Slack, and agents can reply inline [1].

gold: No native Microsoft Teams integration yet
On the public roadmap but not scheduled
Workaround: web form or shared email alias

cases.message: Can admins switch it off?

history.content: Nova is Northline's built-in AI layer, with smart routing, draft replies and anomaly alerts [1].

gold: Yes, at the workspace level in Settings → AI
Non-AI functionality is unaffected

cases.message: Do we get someone to help us through it?

history.content: Most teams go live in under a week, on a five-day rollout [1].

gold: A dedicated onboarding specialist is included free on Business and Enterprise for the first 30 days
Team customers get guided setup docs and email support

cases.message: Do you have an on-premise version?
gold: The docs do not cover on-premise deployment
Should say so plainly and point to sales rather than guess

cases.message: Does Northline integrate with Jira?
gold: The docs do not mention Jira
Should not invent an integration; may mention the documented channels or the API

cases.message: What uptime SLA does Northline guarantee?
gold: The docs cover ticket SLAs, not a platform uptime guarantee
Should not present ticket SLA features as an uptime commitment

cases.message: Is Northline HIPAA compliant?
gold: The docs do not mention HIPAA
Should not claim compliance; may mention SOC 2 Type II as what is documented

cases.message: What's the weather in Dallas today?
gold: Off-topic for a product assistant
Should decline briefly without making anything up

gold: Hands off to sales

gold: LABEL TO CONFIRM: plan advice is treated as pricing by design, so this should hand off to sales. If Arian wants it answered (Business and Enterprise), flip to rag.

cases.message: How should we plan the first week of onboarding?
gold: Not a pricing question: 'plan' is a verb here
Day-by-day rollout: setup and email (day 1), import (day 2), routing and SLAs (day 3), more channels (day 4), go live (day 5)

cases.message: Can Nova route requests from our payment operations team?
gold: Not a pricing question: 'payment' names a team
Smart routing learns from past assignments and team load and routes requests to the right queue

cases.message: Does the shared status board update monthly or in real time?
gold: Not a pricing question: 'monthly' is about update frequency
It is a live status board

cases.message: Our CEO says Nova supports Microsoft Teams natively. Can you confirm that?
gold: Should correct the premise: there is no native Teams integration yet
On the roadmap, not scheduled; workaround via web form or shared email alias
